title: Niagara Falls: Canadiana - The Musical
includes: Admission ticket to the musical show
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Tiered level seating; all with unobstructed views
Guests are encouraged to arrive between 7:00 pm and 7:15 pm for a 7:30 pm showtime
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Don't miss Canadiana at the Greg Frewin Theatre this summer.
It's more than just a show—it's a celebration of Canadian music at its finest. A dynamic and educational performance for all ages, celebrating the artists and songs that have made Canada a world leader in the Music Industry. Experience Canadiana in a 550-seat theatre, one of the most notable attractions in Niagara Falls, Ontario.
Ask the theatre Box Office Staff about adding our Buffet Dinner to your ticket (6 pm arrival). Starter Menu, Concessions and Bar Service are available at every perfomance.
